author: Hodgson, 1845
summary: 국내에는 지금까지 기록이 10건이 안 되는 길잃은새이다. 히말라야 중부에서 중국 중·남부, 인도차이나, 대만에 걸친 산지 상록활엽수림의 하층에 사는 텃새로, 겨울에는 낮은 곳으로 내려온다. 덤불이 빽빽한 숲 바닥에서 숨어 지내며 먹이를 찾는다.

points.ko: 거의 검게 보이는 짙은 파란 몸(수컷)
points.en: dark blue body, looking almost black in shade (male)
brown body with a whitish throat crescent (female)
long white patches on the basal part of the outer tail feathers

sexes.male: 온몸이 검은빛 도는 짙은 남색이고 얼굴과 아랫면은 더 검다. 이마·눈썹과 어깨에 밝은 코발트빛 파란 무늬가 있고, 꼬리깃 기부가 희어 꼬리를 펴면 흰 무늬가 드러난다.
sexes.female: 온몸이 적갈색 기 도는 갈색이고, 꼬리 기부의 흰 무늬는 수컷과 같다.

young: 갓 둥지를 떠난 어린새는 온몸이 적갈색이고, 깃마다 밝은 담황색 점이나 깃대 줄무늬가 있어 얼룩덜룩해 보인다.

art.subject: White-tailed Robin (Myiomela leucura), adult male, a vagrant in shaded Korean island forest: almost entirely blackish-blue, darkest on the face and underparts; forehead and brow shining cobalt-blue, and a glossy blue patch at the shoulder; long white patches covering the basal two-thirds of the outer tail feathers, mostly hidden when the tail is closed but flashing as long white side panels when it is spread; a small white patch on the side of the neck usually hidden. Bill black; eye dark; legs blackish.
art.pose: standing on a mossy rock in the forest understorey with the tail closed, side view
art.scene: dark evergreen ravine forest with ferns and mossy rocks on a southern Korean island in spring (April), subdued light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, standing on a mossy rock, side view: slim upright long-tailed chat, dark blue body looking almost black in shade, shining blue forehead and brow, blue shoulder patch, black bill, long dark tail slightly spread to show long white patches on the basal part of the outer feathers

adult female, standing on the forest floor, side view: plain brown upperparts, paler buff-brown underparts, whitish crescent on the throat, dark bill, long brown tail with long white patches on the basal part of the outer feathers
art.build: A medium-sized, long-tailed forest chat, clearly larger than a sparrow, slim and upright on fairly long legs; no crest, the crown feathers lie flat. Bill black, slender, shorter than the head. Legs long and blackish. Wings short and rounded; the wingtips reach only a little past the tail base. Tail long and broad, blackish-blue, the outer feathers white on their basal two-thirds, mostly hidden when the tail is closed and showing as long white side panels when it is spread.
avoid: Do not paint a white tail tip or wholly white outer tail feathers; the white is a patch near the base of the outer feathers.
Do not paint an orange or white belly (niltavas, bluethroats); the male's underparts are blackish-blue.
Do not show the hidden white neck patch as a large obvious collar.
Do not make the bird bright sky-blue overall; it looks almost black in shade, with only the forehead and shoulder glossed blue.
